scientific_state: Fixed experiment complete; public packaging candidate, not a deployment claim

model.family: Prescribed-field Cartesian orbits and independent finite-time action-angle perturbation theory
model.observable: Difference Fplus minus Fminus in total accumulated bar-mediated angular-momentum transfer
model.units: Dimensionless code angular momentum; fixed target population mass1, no realized-mass renormalization. No physical length/time calibration is supplied.
model.reference: Same bar history and numerical treatment for exact positive Fplus/Fminus populations; half-amplitude is a separate paired weak-law control

populations.reference_DF: Positive isotropic isochrone distribution function F0
populations.initial_continuum_constraints: Same density, all even velocity moments and zero mean streaming; these do not imply identical resonant directional derivatives

forecast.method: Second-order finite-time CBE response from unforced frequencies, physical orbital Fourier coefficients and analytic twin DF derivative; no forced outcome fitting
forecast.full_complex_series_equation: C2=-(2pi)^3/2 * sum_n n_phi integral (n dot d(Fplus-Fminus)/dJ)*|Phi_n(J)|^2*|integral_0^T epsilon(t)exp(i*(n dot Omega-n_phi*Omega_bar)*t)dt|^2 d^3J
forecast.Fourier_convention: Phi_n are full real-field complex coefficients per unit amplitude. Positive m=2 coefficient has the real-field factor1/2; including conjugates in the full series requires its prefactor1/2.
forecast.action_convention: Delaunay(Jr,L,Lz); node frequency0, corotation slow action Js=Lz/2. Physical observable is Lz, not Js.
forecast.radial_tail_status: p4 remains numerically unqualified; p6/p8 are provisional numerical-proxy qualifications, not nonlinear-error bounds
forecast.qualification_scope: Frozen pre-evolution unforced numerical-proxy assessment; current driven magnitude and amplitude-law decisions are separately recorded below.
forecast.inclination_measure: mu=Lz/L, dLz=L*dmu; positive m=2 has k=-2,0,2. Full radial integer sums are retained or given explicit numerical tail proxies.

sampling.independent_unit: Whole independently seeded action library and independent scrambled radial/in-plane phase rule
sampling.paired_controls: Pi/2 azimuth partners; physical velocity-reversed senses; full/half amplitudes; first2 libraries for timestep and phase refinements
sampling.proposal_measure: On positive-Lz hemisphere, p_fold=2*q_full/Mq; raw familymass=Mq/N, r=F0/q_full, h=alpha*|Lz|*h_p/q_full
sampling.sampled_contraction: C=sum_i rawmass_i*h_i*(Bpro_i-Bretro_i); no further factor2,1/2 or(2pi)^3. Physical half-mass cancels folded proposal factor2.

endpoint_data.population_transfer_context_scope: Raw Fplus/Fminus/reference total-transfer operands explain contrast versus total transfer. No extra statistical qualification or multiplicity claim is added for these context quantities.

uncertainty.family_rule: Student-t7 quantile(1-.05/18), Bonferroni for9 two-sided comparisons. Comparisons need not be independent; RQMC/heavy-tail coverage is nominal and uncalibrated.
uncertainty.numerical_proxy: For each population/amplitude:2*max(first2 libraries|half-step-base|)+2*max(first2 libraries|16phase-8phase|); empirical proxy, not a rigorous bound.
uncertainty.paired_amplitude_proxy: N_full+4*N_half; paired-library covariance, no independence assumption and no duplicate forecast proxy
uncertainty.magnitude_decision: Support if |mean-forecast|+sampling+numerical+forecast_proxy <=.05*max(|mean|-sampling-numerical,0); contradiction uses corresponding conservative upper actual-signal target; else unresolved
uncertainty.sign_decision: Qualified if |mean|>sampling+numerical; still conditional on nominal coverage/proxies
uncertainty.intermediate_time_status: Frozen9-comparison family applies to endpointT40 only. History bands, if shown, must be labelled pointwise/descriptive; no simultaneous-in-time claim.

recorded_history.observable: Recorded accumulated transfer contrasts, not instantaneous torque
recorded_history.uncomputed_times: No numerical result is provided between recorded times. A display interpolation must be labelled as interpolation.

exclusions: No live halo or bar response
No observed-galaxy matching or bar-formation prediction
No universal confidence coverage or rigorous numerical-error bound
Numerical formulations and saved-arithmetic review are internal verification, not external peer review

scientific_provenance.independent_scalar_reconstruction: 245 saved-JSON arithmetic comparisons pass; no orbit rerun, full-array re-contraction, proof of proxy coverage or external review
scientific_provenance.full_array_evidence: Real full states, impulses and41trace times are retained and hashed in the experiment archive. This small extraction does not assert public availability of those arrays.

reuse: Original derived-data extraction and accompanying text follow existing project MIT reuse conditions; third-party numerical software retains its own licence.
